question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given according to this prohibition?
premises: A reviler of Shiva is named.
A slanderer of the Kula Bhairava is named.
The teaching must not be given to such persons.
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
plain_english: O goddess, it must not be given to a reviler of Shiva or to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
